name: Agent Skills Hub
summary: Security-graded directory of open-source agent skills and MCP servers at agentskillshub.top, operated by BRICKAI / GoSailGlobal LLC. Freemium; MIT; not the .dev site.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (a public GitHub pull request proposed the directory; counts, prices, and rules below come from official pages fetched 2026-11-23, not from the PR). Agent Skills Hub (AgentSkillsHub) is the directory at https://agentskillshub.top/, operated by BRICKAI / GoSailGlobal LLC and founded by Jason Zhu (official launch date 2026-03-08). Official ai-info and llms.txt state it is not affiliated with similarly named domains including agentskillshub.dev (that distinct site also returned HTTP 200 and is not this listing). Live counts re-fetched 2026-11-28: official llms.txt and https://agentskillshub.top/ai-info/ (signed 'Last verified & updated: 2026-11-28') say the catalog indexes 287,000+ open-source AI agent skills, MCP servers, and tools from GitHub (refreshed every 8 hours) and security-grades 146,000+ repositories against 44 published rules (covering 99% of skills over 100 stars and 99% over 1,000). These counts move daily: 2026-11-23 pages said 282,000+ / 143,000+, and a 2026-11-28 hand-off note cited 285k+ / 144k+; treat any number as a dated snapshot. Older PR text said 276k / 138k / 43 rules. The Zenodo security-census snapshot at https://zenodo.org/records/21292799 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21292799; do not cite the doi.org redirect) is CC BY 4.0 (re-confirmed 2026-11-28 via the Zenodo API: title 'AI Agent Skills Security Grades (130K)', license cc-by-4.0, published 2026-07-10); official pages also mention 130,173 graded items in that deposit, which can lag the live catalog. License split (official NOTICE.md at https://github.com/zhuyansen/agent-skills-hub/blob/main/NOTICE.md, fetched 2026-11-28): the source code is MIT, but the hosted catalog data (skill records, scores, security grades, quality analyses, scenario rankings, descriptions) is not licensed for republication (© 2026 Jason Zhu, all rights reserved), the hosted API/database serves only the site, and the name/brand 'Agent Skills Hub' and the agentskillshub.top domain are excluded; listed repositories keep their own licenses. NOTICE.md says to ask via GitHub issues or @GoSailGlobal on X to use the data in a product or research. The `license: MIT` field of this entry therefore covers the code only. https://github.com/zhuyansen/agent-skills-hub is MIT (Copyright (c) 2026 Jason Zhu), not archived, created 2026-03-06 and pushed 2026-11-23T05:57:58Z (2026-11-23 06:57:58 Europe/Stockholm). Pricing should be read from https://agentskillshub.top/enterprise/ (HTTP 200): Free is $0 forever, no card (catalog, quality score, basic scan, scenario pages). Pro is $29/year as an early-supporter price (standard $49/year) with deep README search, CSV/JSON export, and a CLI and MCP API key. Team CI Gate is $49/month (3–20 engineers) and still says '43 SlowMist-aligned security checks' on /enterprise/ (re-checked 2026-11-28), while the same /enterprise/ page's intro, /how-we-grade/, /ai-info/ and llms.txt say 44 published rules; the discrepancy is unresolved on the live site. Enterprise is listed at $10K–$30K/year per department (starter $10K, standard $20K, business $30K; 200+ engineers or regulated industries start at $50K/year). The same /ai-info/ page (re-checked 2026-11-28) still says 'Paid plans from $39/yr (Pro Deep Search); Fast-Track Security Audit $49 per skill; Team CI Skill Gate $29/mo. See /enterprise/' — these conflict with /enterprise/ (Pro $29/yr early-supporter, standard $49/yr; Team CI Gate $49/mo). Both sets are recorded with their sources; /ai-info/ itself points to /enterprise/ for pricing. This entry treats /enterprise/ as the pricing page and flags the mismatch. Documented `npx -y @agentskillshub/mcp` and CLI installs were not executed. Grading is a published rule-based method, not a substitute for your own review before installing a skill. No signup or spend.

agent_access.notes: The public catalog, analyzer, llms.txt, and /ai-info/ need no login. Official pages also document a local MCP as `npx -y @agentskillshub/mcp` (tools search_skills, audit_skill, get_skill_install) and a CLI; those packages were not installed or run. Paid Pro/Team plans add a CLI and MCP API key according to /enterprise/. No hosted streamable-HTTP MCP URL was used as mcp_endpoint. Code is MIT but catalog data and the name are not (NOTICE.md). No account was created.
